paragraphs.text: Ramiro Alcázar Peniche participated in Shipment ENS-10-01 on 2010-09-17. Red del Horizonte Azul was linked to Shipment ENS-10-01 on 2010-09-17. Shipment ENS-10-01 occurred at Ensenada on 2010-09-17. A taxi operator with regular fares on the Ensenada waterfront reported that Alcázar, the maritime logistics figure the panga crews call El Remo, organized a load of 180 kg of cannabis out of Ensenada by sea toward the beaches south of Los Angeles. The operator stated that the load was first moved to the launch point in a tractor-trailer the crews call Tráiler Luz Dorada and then transferred to two pangas at night.

Shipment ENS-10-01 transited Ensenada maritime route on 2010-09-17. Gonzalo Ferreira Luján led Red del Horizonte Azul from 2010-05-30 until 2014-11-20. The operator described the maritime route as the network's preferred method for cannabis because the loads are bulky and the crossing by land attracts canine inspection. The operator characterized Ferreira as the person who set the schedule for panga departures and who received a share of each load crossed. The operator added that the pangas return before dawn and are hauled onto trailers at a boatyard whose owner is paid by the month. The operator believes the same boatyard was used for the network's earlier runs.

The reporting office assesses the operator as having regular but incidental access to crew conversations. The source did not observe the pangas depart and reported the launch from accounts given by crew members who used the taxi. This information has not been corroborated by a second independent source at the time of writing. The reporting office continues to collect on the entities named in this report.
